id.description: Unique identifier representing a specific listing (listing_id).

lastModifiedAt.description: Date/time that the listing performance report was last modified.

portalMetrics.description: Array of portal metrics for the listing campaign.

productMetrics.description: Array of product metrics for the listing campaign.

DataSourceLastUpdated.description: Contains dates indicating data source currency

listingEvents.description: Date that the data for Web, Mobile, SRP Impressions was last refreshed.

audienceMaximiser.description: Date that the data for Audience Maximiser was last refreshed. The date will be null if there is no Audience Maximiser add on.

eBrochure.description: Date that the data for eBrochure was last refreshed. The date will be null if there is no eBrochure add on. **Not available for Commercial listings.*

bundledNotifications.description: Date that the data for Bundled Notifications was last refreshed. The date will be null if there were no Bundled Notifications sent for this listing.

amplify.description: Date that the data for Luxe Home Page was last refreshed. The date will be null if there is no Luxe Home Page add on.

href.description: Hyperlink to a Campaign API resource

Listing.description: Listing to which listing performance report relates.

id.description: Unique identifier representing a specific listing.

externalListingId.description: External listing identifier provided by the agency or CRM platform.

agencyId.description: Unique identifier representing the listing agency.

metricName.description:
Name of the performance metric being measured.
Supports the following metric names:
* listingEvents (portal listing events for portal metrics)
* marketPerformance (market performance metrics for portal metrics)
* audienceSourcePageView (audience source page view metrics for portal metrics)
* audienceSourcePhoneReveal (audience source phone reveal metrics for portal metrics)
* productSourcePageView (product source page view metrics for portal metrics)
* emailEnquiryEvents (email enquiry events metrics for portal metrics)
* intentToInspectEvents (inspect intention metrics for portal metrics)
* productSourceCampaignExposure (product source campaign exposure metrics for portal metrics)
* uniqueVisitorsEvents (unique visitors events metrics for portal metrics)
* videoViews (video views metrics for portal metrics)
* productEvents (product events metrics for product metrics)
* uniqueImpression (unique impression metrics for product metrics' audienceMaximiser)
* publisherSourceAdImpression (publisher source ad impression metrics for product metrics' audienceMaximiser)
* suburbs (suburbs metrics for product metrics' amplify)

metricType.description:
Type of the performance metric being measured.
Supports the following metric types:
* sum (integer sum)

metricPeriods.description: Array of measured periods for the performance metric.

period.description: Calendar period the metric values are totalled for.

metricValues.description: Array of individual metric values for the period.

name.description: Name of the individual performance data point being measured.

value.description: Value of the individual performance data point being measured.

portalName.description:
Name of the advertising portal on which the listing or project activity occurred.
Supports the following advertising portals:
* realestate_au (realestate.com.au)

all.description: Array of performance metrics, totalled for the whole campaign reporting period.

daily.description: Array of performance metrics, totalled for daily periods.

productName.description: This is the name of the add-on product eg. audienceMaximiser, amplify, eBrochure, and bundledNotifications.

productPurchases.description: Array of performance metrics for each purchaseId

purchaseId.description:
Also known as a booking id or payment id, this represent the purchase of an add-on products for
which metrics are supplied. eg Audience Maximiser

purchaseType.description:
Type of product purchased. Only used when product name is audienceMaximiser. Indicates the type of Audience Maximiser campaign purchased.
Supports the following purchase types:
* click
* impression
* null

all.description: Array of performance metrics, totalled for the whole campaign reporting period.

daily.description: Array of performance metrics, totalled for daily periods.

ReportingPeriod.description: Reporting period (inclusive) to which the listing performance report applies.

startDate.description: Start date of the reporting period (inclusive).

endDate.description: End date of the reporting period (inclusive).
